$comment: Machine-readable provenance record for every third-party component the EcoIQ Engineering OS evaluated. Narrative rationale: docs/ECOIQ-ENGINEERING-OS.md. Pre-existing design/frontend tooling is recorded separately in docs/AI-TOOL-INSTALLATION-MANIFEST.md and is not duplicated here. Decisions: adopt = used as-is; adapt = pattern reimplemented locally, no code vendored; isolate = present but walled off from the Django runtime; defer = blocked on a credential or decision; reject = not used, with a reason.
audit_method: GitHub REST API metadata plus direct reads of each repository's own installer, hook, authentication and skill files. No candidate repository was cloned, installed, or executed. No installer, hook, MCP server, or binary from any candidate was run.

components.name: Superpowers
components.ecoiq_use_case: Engineering-workflow discipline: planning, TDD, systematic debugging, verification-before-completion, code review.
components.what_was_adapted: The verification-before-completion and release-discipline pattern informed .claude/skills/ecoiq-release-gate/SKILL.md. No files copied.
components.security_notes: Ships hooks/session-start, a SessionStart hook that reads skills/using-superpowers/SKILL.md and injects it into every session's context as EXTREMELY_IMPORTANT. Inspected: local file reads only, no network, no subprocess. Rejected anyway on architecture grounds — unconditional context injection is the opposite of the progressive disclosure this OS requires, and it would outrank EcoIQ's own CLAUDE.md rules on every task.
components.overlap: Its 14 skills overlap the generic engineering skills already available in this environment; the EcoIQ-specific gap it did not fill is the domain layer, which is what ecoiq-* skills provide.

components.name: Marketing Skills
components.ecoiq_use_case: Positioning, ICP definition, conversion paths, lead magnets, ethical CRO, experiment design.
components.what_was_adapted: Structure only — the ICP/positioning/conversion framing in .claude/skills/ecoiq-growth/SKILL.md is populated entirely from EcoIQ's own leads.AccessRequest fields, ecoiq_commerce tiers, and existing URL routes. Its validate-skills.sh is the precedent for core/management/commands/validate_skills.py, reimplemented in Python rather than copied.
components.security_notes: The URL as supplied returns HTTP 404. The real repository is `marketingskills` (no hyphen). Repositories were not confused for one another: metadata was confirmed against the owner's repository listing before use. No installer or hook at top level; a shell validator script exists but was not executed.
components.overlap: Generic marketing advice; the binding constraint for EcoIQ is KPI 114 (Consumer Protection & Anti-Manipulation), which no third-party marketing skill encodes.

components.name: Anthropic Skills — brand-guidelines
components.version_observed: repository pushed 2026-08-21; skill directory contains SKILL.md (2235 B) and LICENSE.txt (11345 B)
components.license: per-skill LICENSE.txt in the skill directory; the repository root declares no SPDX licence
components.ecoiq_use_case: Document-structure pattern for a brand skill: colours, typography, application, technical detail.
components.what_was_adapted: The section structure only. Its content defines *Anthropic's* brand (Poppins/Lora, Anthropic's palette) and would be actively wrong applied to EcoIQ. .claude/skills/ecoiq-brand/SKILL.md is populated exclusively from frontend/app/src/design/tokens.ts, static/brand/ecoiq-logo.svg, templates/base.html, and ai_gateway/prompts.py.
components.security_notes: No scripts. Two files, both inert.
components.overlap: ui-ux-pro-max:brand is already installed and generic; EcoIQ tokens outrank both per CLAUDE.md rule 1.

components.name: Claude SEO
components.version_observed: default branch main, pushed 2026-08-25; installer pins tag v2.2.5
components.ecoiq_use_case: Coverage checklist for technical SEO, structured data, hreflang, and AI-search discoverability.
components.what_was_adapted: Check coverage only. Implemented natively as core/management/commands/seo_audit.py, which runs offline against this repository's own robots.txt, sitemap, templates and static files. No files copied.
components.permissions_required: none as adapted. Adopting it directly would need filesystem write to ~/.claude/, an isolated Python runtime, a Chromium download, and Google API credentials for its Search Console features.
components.security_notes: install.sh / install.ps1 clone the repository into ~/.claude/skills/seo and ~/.claude/agents, invoke `claude-seo setup` (which creates a Python runtime and installs requirements.txt), copy hooks with the execute bit set, and rewrite documentation to absolute binary paths. Running an unreviewed third-party installer that provisions a runtime and registers executable hooks is prohibited here, so it was not run. Its 25 sub-skills and 18 sub-agents would also load far more surface area than EcoIQ's progressive-disclosure requirement allows.
components.overlap: No existing EcoIQ SEO tooling — this was a genuine gap, now filled natively.
components.rollback: Delete core/management/commands/seo_audit.py, core/tests_seo_audit.py, .claude/skills/ecoiq-seo-audit/, and the CI step.

components.name: Remotion
components.version_observed: remotion and @remotion/cli pinned at 4.0.190 in frontend/remotion/package.json
components.ecoiq_use_case: Programmatic video briefs — country transition, company ESG risk, impact explainers.
components.what_was_adapted: Nothing new installed. Already present at frontend/remotion/ with three working compositions. .claude/skills/ecoiq-remotion/SKILL.md documents the existing workspace and hard-codes the isolation rule.
components.permissions_required: none for Django. Local `npm install` pulls a headless Chromium (hundreds of MB, gitignored); node_modules is not installed in this checkout.
components.security_notes: Build-time only and must stay so — never in requirements.txt, build.sh, predeploy.sh, start.sh, render.yaml, or CI. Django serves already-rendered files from static/video/ via WhiteNoise.
components.licence_flag: ACTION REQUIRED — Remotion's licence is free for individuals, nonprofits, and for-profit organisations with up to 3 employees. A for-profit organisation above that threshold must buy a Company Licence (remotion.pro). EcoIQ is a commercial platform, so this needs a deliberate check against current headcount. This is a commercial/licensing decision for the user, not something resolvable in code.
components.overlap: None — it is the only video authoring path.
components.rollback: Delete .claude/skills/ecoiq-remotion/. frontend/remotion/ pre-dates this work and is unchanged.

components.name: Anthropic Skills — skill-creator
components.version_observed: already available in this environment as the skill `anthropic-skills:skill-creator`
components.license: per-skill LICENSE.txt in the skill directory
components.what_was_adapted: Adopted as-is by reference — it is already installed, so vendoring a second copy would be a duplicate. .claude/skills/ecoiq-skill-creator/SKILL.md adds only the EcoIQ-specific layer it cannot know: the ecoiq-* naming rule, the link-resolution requirement, the provenance-row requirement, and the validate_skills gate.
components.security_notes: Already present in the environment; nothing new introduced.
components.overlap: Intentional — the project skill defers to it for mechanics.

components.name: MassGen
components.ecoiq_use_case: Requested as a source of file-search and code-navigation patterns.
components.security_notes: It is a multi-agent orchestration runtime that drives frontier models, not a search library. Installing ~631 MB and a second agent runtime to obtain file-search guidance is disproportionate, and it would sit alongside the LangGraph orchestration this repository already has (langgraph_orchestration/), which the codebase explicitly built to avoid a second agent runtime. Licence is also unresolved (NOASSERTION), and it is the least-maintained candidate (last push 2026-06-12).
components.overlap: Repository navigation is already fast and native: ripgrep, `rg --files`, and Django-aware inspection. No measurable gain was identified.

components.name: Agent Skills for Context Engineering
components.ecoiq_use_case: Progressive disclosure, context scoping, output summarisation, identifier preservation.
components.what_was_adapted: Applied as methodology, consistent with how docs/AI-SKILL-ROUTER.md already treats progressive disclosure. Concretely: every ecoiq-* skill has narrow triggers and a 'Not for' clause, descriptions are capped at 500 characters and enforced by validate_skills, and skills link to canonical files rather than restating them so context is loaded on demand.
components.security_notes: No installer or MCP definition at top level. Not vendored — 35 MB of collection for a set of principles Anthropic already documents natively is not proportionate.
components.overlap: Substantially overlaps guidance already recorded in docs/AI-SKILL-ROUTER.md and docs/AI-TOOL-INSTALLATION-MANIFEST.md, which class progressive-disclosure as an architecture principle rather than an installable tool.

components.name: Anthropic Skills — web-artifacts-builder
components.version_observed: already available in this environment as `anthropic-skills:web-artifacts-builder`
components.license: per-skill LICENSE.txt in the skill directory
components.ecoiq_use_case: Rapid isolated prototypes — dashboards, calculators, scenario simulators, evidence graphs, KPI explorers.
components.what_was_adapted: Adopted by reference. .claude/skills/ecoiq-prototype/SKILL.md adds the EcoIQ guardrails it cannot know: synthetic data only and visibly labelled, no real company scores, no production endpoints, no credentials, and an explicit promotion path requiring a rebuild through Django plus the React islands.
components.security_notes: Prototypes stay in the session scratchpad, never in frontend/app, templates/, or static/.
components.overlap: None — EcoIQ had no prototyping lane.

components.name: NotebookLM Claude Skill
components.ecoiq_use_case: Requested as an external research connector.
components.what_was_adapted: Nothing installed. A manual import/export boundary was built instead: docs/research-ingest-manifest.schema.json, core/management/commands/validate_research_manifest.py, and .claude/skills/ecoiq-research-ingest/SKILL.md.
components.security_notes: Rejected on three independent grounds, each sufficient, all read from its own AUTHENTICATION.md rather than inferred. (1) It automates a Google account login; performing an account login on a user's behalf is not permitted. (2) It persists Google session cookies to disk — a browser_profile/ directory plus a plaintext state.json re-injected on each run — which authenticates an entire Google account, not a scoped notebook. (3) It uses Patchright, a stealth Playwright fork whose purpose is evading bot detection. It is community-maintained, not an official Google or Anthropic integration, and depends on undocumented internal endpoints.
components.overlap: None — EcoIQ had no external research boundary at all, which is the gap the manual manifest now fills.
